newsitem.title: GERMANY: AVA 1996 profit up, but still no dividend.
newsitem.headline: AVA 1996 profit up, but still no dividend.

text.p: German retailer AVA AG said on Thursday that group net profit rose to 29 million marks ($16.9 million) in 1996 from 10.5 million the year earlier, but it still struck its dividend for the second year running to boost its equity.
AVA Allgemeine Handelsgesellschaft der Verbraucher AG also said in a regulatory news release that group sales rose by 12.1 percent in the first quarter of this year to 2.3 billion marks.

The statement, issued after a meeting of AVA's supervisory board, noted that the rapid expansion of store space last year had raised costs. AVA's Nanz and Marktkauf units also suffered drops in turnover and had to cope with tough price competition.
In results already announced, AVA said that group turnover rose 6.3 percent last year to 9.1 billion marks. Of the total, non-retail sales were 470 million marks, up from 368 million.
On a same-store basis, sales were up by 1.7 percent in 1996 after a fall of 2.4 percent the year before.
AVA's annual shareholders meeting will take place on August 20.
